verses.text: A song of ascents. Out of the depths I cry to You, O LORD!

segments.text: A song of ascents. Out of the depths I cry to You, O LORD!

verses.text: O Lord, hear my voice; let Your ears be attentive to my plea for mercy.

segments.text: O Lord, hear my voice; let Your ears be attentive to my plea for mercy.

verses.text: If You, O LORD, kept track of iniquities, then who, O Lord, could stand?

segments.text: If You, O LORD, kept track of iniquities, then who, O Lord, could stand?

verses.text: But with You there is forgiveness, so that You may be feared.

segments.text: But with You there is forgiveness, so that You may be feared.

verses.text: I wait for the LORD; my soul does wait, and in His word I put my hope.

segments.text: I wait for the LORD; my soul does wait, and in His word I put my hope.

verses.text: My soul waits for the Lord more than watchmen wait for the morning—more than watchmen wait for the morning.

segments.text: My soul waits for the Lord more than watchmen wait for the morning—more than watchmen wait for the morning.

verses.text: O Israel, put your hope in the LORD, for with the LORD is loving devotion, and with Him is redemption in abundance.

segments.text: O Israel, put your hope in the LORD, for with the LORD is loving devotion, and with Him is redemption in abundance.

verses.text: And He will redeem Israel from all iniquity.
